text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
QADISSIYA - Iraq refutes new U.S. allegations and lies.
- Iraqi journalists choose Uday Saddam Hussein chairman of their union.
- Moroccan newspaper says Washington insists on continuation of sanctions on Iraq.
- Diplomatic source in New York says U.N. sanctions committee adopts proposal to speed up measures for implementing oil-for-food deal.
- Iraq strongly protests against Iran's violation of its sovereignty.
- Iraqi parliamentary delegation leaves for Damascus.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Spain to hold industrial exhibition in Baghdad.
- Indian economic delegation to visit Iraq.
